summary: Pete Prisco of CBSSports.com previews all 32 teams in the NFL's Week 12 (Thanksgiving week) against the spread and straight up. He reports he is now above .500 ATS at 80-78-6 and 99-65 straight up, and picks winners game by game, including Jaguars over Texans and Saints over Falcons. Some Thursday and Friday games include actual results, where several of his picks missed or were exceeded.
one_line: Pete Prisco's Week 12 NFL picks, with Jaguars over Texans and Saints over Falcons, plus his updated season records against the spread.
key_facts: Pete Prisco went 8-6 ATS last week and is now 80-78-6 against the spread for the season, over .500 for the first time.
Prisco went 10-4 straight up last week, improving to 99-65 straight up for the season.
All 32 teams play in Week 12, which Prisco calls a tougher challenge; he is aiming for an 11-5 ATS and 12-4 straight-up week.
Prisco picked the Lions 31, Packers 27 on Thursday, but the Packers won 29-22.
Prisco picked the Cowboys 32, Commanders 16; Dallas won 45-10.
Prisco picked the 49ers 28, Seahawks 19; San Francisco won 31-13, and he noted Geno Smith was banged up.
Prisco picked the Dolphins 21, Jets 16 on Friday with Tim Boyle starting at quarterback for the Jets; Miami won 34-13.
Prisco picked the Jaguars 27, Texans 23 for first place in the AFC South, noting the Texans had won 10 of 11 against Jacksonville in recent years.
Prisco picked the Saints 24, Falcons 20, calling the Saints the only .500 team in the division and citing their defense.
The Steelers fired offensive coordinator Matt Canada this week; Prisco picked Pittsburgh 23, Bengals 21 with Jake Browning starting for the Bengals in place of Joe Burrow.
Prisco picked the Browns 20, Broncos 12, noting Cleveland is 7-3, Denver has won four straight, and rookie Dorian Thompson-Robinson makes his first road start.
Prisco picked the Eagles 31, Bills 30 and the Ravens 30, Chargers 23, noting the Ravens will miss tight end Mark Andrews.
Prisco picked the Vikings 24, Bears 14 on Monday night, with Minnesota's defense getting the best of Justin Fields.
Prisco recommends the SportsLine Projection Model for a more analytical approach to Week 12 picks.
